Use this rule to hold a project to one naming convention, for example no underscores or only camelCase. You give it a regular expression, and it reports the names that do not match.

The default pattern, `^.+$`, matches every name, so the rule reports nothing until you set one.

## Examples

```toml bunfig.toml
[lint.rules]
id-match = ["error", "^[^_]+$"]
```

The examples on this page use `^[^_]+$`, which means no underscores.

Reported:

{/* bad {"options": ["^[^_]+$"], "count": 3} */}
```js
const user_name = "Ada";

function load_user(user_id) {}
```

Not reported:

{/* good {"options": ["^[^_]+$"]} */}
```js
const userName = "Ada";

function loadUser(userId) {}
```

A function you call and a property you read may come from code you do not control, so they are not checked:

{/* good {"options": ["^[^_]+$"]} */}
```js
const total = get_total(order.line_items);
```

## Options

The first option is the pattern. The second is an object:

| Option | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `properties` | `false` | Also check the keys of object literals and the properties you assign to. |
| `classFields` | `false` | Also check class fields. Methods are checked either way. |
| `onlyDeclarations` | `false` | Check a name only where it is declared, not where it is used. |
| `ignoreDestructuring` | `false` | Do not check a destructured variable that keeps the name of the property. |

### `properties`

{/* good {"options": ["^[^_]+$"]} */}
```js
const user = { first_name: "Ada" };
user.last_name = "Lovelace";
```

{/* bad {"options": ["^[^_]+$", {"properties": true}], "count": 2} */}
```js
const user = { first_name: "Ada" };
user.last_name = "Lovelace";
```

### `classFields`

{/* bad {"options": ["^[^_]+$"], "count": 1} */}
```js
class User {
  first_name = "Ada";
  full_name() {}
}
```

{/* bad {"options": ["^[^_]+$", {"classFields": true}], "count": 2} */}
```js
class User {
  first_name = "Ada";
  full_name() {}
}
```

### `onlyDeclarations`

{/* bad {"options": ["^[^_]+$"]} */}
```js
if (legacy_mode) {
  start();
}
```

{/* good {"options": ["^[^_]+$", {"onlyDeclarations": true}]} */}
```js
if (legacy_mode) {
  start();
}
```

{/* bad {"options": ["^[^_]+$", {"onlyDeclarations": true}]} */}
```js
const legacy_mode = true;
```

### `ignoreDestructuring`

{/* bad {"options": ["^[^_]+$"]} */}
```js
const { user_id } = row;
```

{/* good {"options": ["^[^_]+$", {"ignoreDestructuring": true}]} */}
```js
const { user_id } = row;
```

A new name that you choose is still checked:

{/* bad {"options": ["^[^_]+$", {"ignoreDestructuring": true}]} */}
```js
const { user_id: owner_id } = row;
```
